web_fixture.title: Colehurst L-Series: E-03 label errors
web_fixture.snippet: E-03 means the label roll is empty or the gap sensor is dusty; reload the roll and clean the sensor.
web_fixture.content:
# Colehurst L-Series - E-03 label errors

- E-03 | Cause label roll empty or gap sensor dusty | Action reload the roll and clean the sensor

The L-Series prints die-cut labels; a missed gap reads as an empty
roll. Clean the sensor with the included swab, not solvents.
